name: @cf-worker-apps/cloud-agent

scripts.build: npm run build:pi && npm run build:events
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check && npm run auth-check && npm run admin-check && npm run control-check

description: Cloudflare Agents and Pi with durable team-chat threads and SSO administration.
